title: Supplement label dataset: label facts of 201 supplements, 99 protein bar flavors and 112 full label panels
description:
Label facts read off the Supplement Facts and Nutrition Facts panels of best-selling US supplements and protein bars: protein and calories per serving, protein per 100 kcal, the doses printed for creatine, magnesium, vitamin D, omega-3 and others, and the third-party certifications printed on the pack.

Version 2026.11.25 adds the full Supplement Facts / Nutrition Facts panels of 112 products (supplement-panels.csv), each with its source page and read date.

Sources: the brand's own product page, the NIH Dietary Supplement Label Database (DSLD) or Open Food Facts. No lab testing: the dataset records what the label prints. The live table with each product's full label is at healthworldlabels.com/data/supplement-labels.
